title: Show HN: OS Grokbot, can run on Claude/codex subs
text: Made a provider-agnostic, entirely locally hostable GrokBot that wraps around your tmux-based terminals - which means, your claude/codex/etc. subscriptions can run inside of it. It is better at long-term tasks, business workflows, and operational work. We have not yet had a chance to run the benchmarks.
author: alpbahadur

title: Show HN: Vondet – A planning board Claude keeps, so you don't have to
text:
Hi HN,

Vondet is a planning board, but you don't write on it. Claude writes to Vondet via an MCP connection.

As I worked on my product with Claude, my Markdown files gradually piled up. There were files like “beta plan”, “v1 plan”, and “development plan v0.5.” I asked Claude to tidy them up. It created a new file “next-milestone plan v0.1” Haha.

I spent too much time trying to remember what I planned. So I built a tool to keep plans and decisions in one place. It's ready for Claude to refer to in future sessions.

Claude can use the board to: - Read: Tasks, decision logs, topics - Plan: Capture, update, and order tasks - Record: Decisions

Vondet works through your conversation with Claude via MCP. I would appreciate it if you could try it in your own Claude.

How to try it: 1. Sign up at Vondet(Magic link, Github, and Google login are supported). 2. Connect MCP to your Claude. 3. Try asking Claude to record a development plan on the board.

How do you all manage your development plans and tasks? I would appreciate any feedback, and interest.
author: mas42

title: Ask HN: Non-Malicious Bots
text:
When I ask an AI to load a link, sometimes it can load it, and sometimes it can't (and I have to copy paste the text myself).

Sometimes it can load it even when it has the "checking if you're a malicious bot". I'm wondering how that works. Isn't AI scraper traffic literally the thing that page is designed to stop?

Do they let Google, OpenAI etc. user agents through? Or do those companies just have a bunch of guys in a warehouse somewhere with Chrome open, forwarding the AI's HTTP requests?
author: andai
